Hello team,

We've prepared a new Kubernetes Deployment for the application titled **my-app**. This deployment utilizes the `apps/v1` API version, ensuring compatibility with the current cluster capabilities and taking advantage of the latest workload features.

Please review the manifest and let us know if any adjustments are needed before we proceed with the rollout. The resource is defined as a Deployment, so it will manage the desired number of pod replicas automatically.
